units.text: I begin to sing about Poseidon, the great god, mover
of the earth and fruitless sea, god of the
deep who is also lord of Helicon and wide Aegae. A two-fold
office the gods allotted you, O Shaker of the Earth,
to be a tamer of horses and a saviour of ships! Hail, Poseidon,
Holder of the Earth, dark-haired lord! O
blessed one, be kindly in heart and help those who voyage in ships!
